**SDI** (Blackmagic DeckLink capture + playout) is **not** included in any artefact of this release. The Blackmagic SDK headers are EULA-gated and are not vendored into this repository, so the release workflow compiles SDI only when an SDK credential is configured — none was for this release. These binaries carry no `sdi` input or output type, do not advertise the `sdi-decklink` capability, and the manager UI hides SDI for nodes running them. To get SDI, build from source with `--features sdi-decklink` and `DECKLINK_SDK_DIR` pointing at the SDK's `Linux/include` — see the [SDI guide](https://bilbycast.com/edge/sdi/). (The `-rockchip` artefact never includes SDI, by design.)
